notes: Step numbers are the main booklet step numbers 1-42; sub-steps share their parent number. Step 42 only places the finished rocket on the cabinet (no new pieces); the minifigure on page 5 is not in the piece list so it is omitted.

Stud-grid positions are approximate (cabinet x 0-9 left-right, y 0-5 front-back, nose of rocket to the left). The rocket is drawn in its own frame, floating above the cabinet, and swivels on axle p99.

The rocket hull is built upside-down (steps 25-30) and flipped in step 31. The lower hull pieces (steps 26-30) hang below the 4x6 plate p61 but are added after it, so they cannot be listed in p61's rests_on; they are given null positions and attached to p61 / each other via other_joins. This also connects them to the rest of the build.
The front panel sub-assembly (steps 16-21) is built then turned sideways, so those pieces have null positions; its attachment to the cabinet is inferred (joined to the curved bricks).
Corner bricks p17/p18 are treated as full 2x2 footprints; the 1x1 bricks p45/p46 complete the cabinet walls beside them, and their grid positions were moved to avoid overlap with those footprints.

Coins p140/p141 sit in the box; p142/p143 are shown loose in the booklet and are joined to the box by contact only so the graph stays connected. Door p95 is hinged to the box. Mechanism parts, flags, cones, coloured round plates, nose cone chain and black pin are off-grid and joined via other_joins; hub joins are inferred from step 15 pictures.
